privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1_body: Shuffla collects and stores login account information (email, name), brand settings, content generation requests, editing results, work history, and payment status — only what is necessary to provide the service. We do not collect payment card details; all payments are processed by third-party providers (TossPayments, NicePay, PayPal).
privacy.s2_body: Collected information is used solely for: user authentication and account management, brand profile storage and AI generation, work history and file storage, payment access verification, and service improvement. We do not sell or share your personal data with third parties for marketing purposes.
privacy.s3_body: To deliver the service, Shuffla integrates with Google OAuth (login), OpenAI and Google Gemini (AI generation), Vercel Blob (file storage), and payment providers (TossPayments, NicePay, PayPal). Only the minimum information required to process each request is shared with these services. Each provider operates under their own privacy policy.
privacy.s4_body: Work history is retained according to your plan (30 days for Free, 90 days for Creator, 365 days for Studio). You may request deletion of your account and all associated data at any time by contacting us.
privacy.s5_body: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data at any time. To exercise these rights, please contact us at the email below.
privacy.s6_body: For privacy inquiries, please contact us at alstnwjd0424@gmail.com or follow us on Instagram at @shuffla.io.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.s1_body: Shuffla is an AI-powered content creation tool that provides brand analysis, card news generation, editing, and download. The service is provided as-is. Generated content is AI-assisted; users are responsible for reviewing and verifying all results before publication or commercial use.
terms.s2_body: You must verify the usage rights and legal compliance of any brand materials, reference images, and generated content you use. You may not use the service to infringe on others' intellectual property, privacy, trademarks, or copyrights, or for any unlawful purpose. You are solely responsible for how you use and publish generated content.
terms.s3_body: Paid plan limits (generation count, retention period, regeneration rights) follow the terms displayed on the pricing page. Subscription access may change based on payment provider status (approval, cancellation, or failure). Refunds are handled in accordance with the respective payment provider's policy. Shuffla does not store payment card information.
terms.s4_body: Shuffla and its AI models generate content based on your inputs. You retain ownership of content you create using the service. Shuffla retains rights to the platform, software, and underlying AI models. You grant Shuffla a limited license to process your inputs solely to deliver the service.
terms.s5_body: Shuffla is not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from use of the service, including but not limited to content accuracy, third-party platform issues, or payment provider failures. Use of AI-generated content in commercial contexts is at your own risk.
terms.s6_body: For service and terms inquiries, please contact us at alstnwjd0424@gmail.com or follow us on Instagram at @shuffla.io.
terms.s7_body: Full refund is available if you have not used any AI generation after purchase. Once you have used the service (card news generation, AI regeneration, or any AI feature), refunds are not available regardless of remaining quota. To request a refund, contact us at alstnwjd0424@gmail.com within 7 days of purchase.
